verses.text: Hereupon His Augustness Fire-Subside gave the fish-hook to his elder brother, exactly according to the Sea-Deity's words of instruction. So thenceforward the elder brother became poorer, and poorer, and, with renewed savage intentions, came to attack him. When he was about to attack His Augustness Fire-Subside, the latter put forth the tide-flowing jewel to drown him; on his expressing grief, he put forth the tide-ebbing jewel to save him. When he had thus been harassed, he bowed his head, saying: "I henceforward will be Thine Augustness's guard by day and night, and respectfully serve thee." So down to the present day his various posturings when drowning are ceaselessly served up.
